title: Student residence work hours
document_excerpt: Third-country students with a study residence permit in Hungary may work during the study period under the published OIF factsheet rules. The public English page states a weekly hour limit during studies and notes separate holiday-period rules where applicable.
reference_summary:
1. OIF publishes student residence rules for third-country nationals in Hungary.
2. Study-permit holders may work during the study period under those rules.
3. The English factsheet states a weekly work-hour limit while studying.
4. Holiday-period work rules can differ from the study-period limit.
5. Always confirm the cited OIF page before relying on an hour figure.

title: Study permit extension steps
document_excerpt: Extension of a residence permit for studies is submitted on Enter Hungary at least thirty days before expiry. Applicants upload required documents and later give biometrics at the regional client service within the stated deadline.
reference_summary:
1. Extend a study residence permit on Enter Hungary.
2. File at least 30 days before the current permit expires.
3. Upload the required documents in the online case.
4. Give biometrics at the regional client service after filing.
5. Missing the biometrics visit can delete the application.

title: Permit length for studies
document_excerpt: A residence permit for the purpose of studies is issued for at least one year and at most three years, adjusted to shorter programmes, and cannot outlast the travel document.
reference_summary:
1. Study residence permits have a minimum length of one year.
2. The maximum length is three years in the general case.
3. Shorter programmes can receive a permit matched to programme length.
4. Validity cannot exceed the applicant travel document.
5. Institutions should follow the OIF higher-education factsheet.

title: EU portal extension conditions
document_excerpt: The EU Immigration Portal page for students in Hungary lists stay conditions for extending a study residence permit, including holding a valid permit when applying and prior residence days inside Hungary.
reference_summary:
1. The EU Immigration Portal covers students in Hungary.
2. Extension requires a still-valid residence permit at filing.
3. Prior residence days in Hungary are part of the stated conditions.
4. Extensions are submitted from inside Hungary via Enter Hungary.
5. Read both the portal page and OIF pages together.

title: Stipendium living allowance
document_excerpt: Stipendium Hungaricum general terms describe monthly living allowances for bachelor and master students and different amounts for doctoral stages, paid by the host institution while status remains active.
reference_summary:
1. Stipendium Hungaricum pays a monthly living allowance.
2. Bachelor and master amounts differ from doctoral amounts.
3. The host institution pays while student status is active.
4. Payment covers twelve months a year or partial-study length.
5. Confirm figures on the current SH general terms PDF.

title: SH operational regulations date
document_excerpt: The Stipendium Hungaricum Operational Regulations state the effective date that replaces older rule sets for the scholarship programme.
reference_summary:
1. SH Operational Regulations govern the scholarship programme.
2. They have a published effective date on the official PDF.
3. Newer regulations replace older Stipendium rule packs.
4. Applicants and hosts should cite the current OR text.
5. Do not rely on withdrawn 2020 rule PDFs.

title: Who ELTE rules cover
document_excerpt: ELTE Academic Regulations for Students apply to persons with student or guest-student status. After status ends, only thesis and final-examination rules may still apply for final exam registrants.
reference_summary:
1. ELTE student regulations cover enrolled and guest students.
2. Student status triggers the main academic rule set.
3. After status ends, coverage narrows.
4. Final-exam registrants may still fall under thesis and exam rules.
5. Check the English Academic Regulations PDF for details.

title: BME language precedence
document_excerpt: The BME Code of Studies English PDF is an official translation. If English and Hungarian texts disagree, the Hungarian version prevails.
reference_summary:
1. BME publishes an English Code of Studies translation.
2. The Hungarian original remains authoritative on conflict.
3. English text helps international students understand rules.
4. Lesson length and breaks are among the coded details.
5. Prefer Hungarian text when the two versions diverge.

title: NJE public regulations
document_excerpt: John von Neumann University lists public regulation and document pages for students, including academic and administrative materials on the English site.
reference_summary:
1. NJE hosts a public regulations and documents index.
2. Students use it to find academic and admin rules.
3. English pages point to university-authored texts.
4. Always open the linked official document, not a copy.
5. Rules can change; check the current university page.

title: Directive 2016/801 students
document_excerpt: Directive (EU) 2016/801 sets EU-level conditions for third-country nationals for research, studies, training, volunteering, pupil exchange, and au pairing, including mobility elements for students.
reference_summary:
1. Directive 2016/801 is an EU legal instrument for students and researchers.
2. It covers third-country nationals in defined categories.
3. Student mobility rules appear in the directive text.
4. National Hungarian rules still implement local procedures.
5. Use EUR-Lex for the authentic directive wording.

title: Enter Hungary student upload
document_excerpt: The Enter Hungary student upload manual explains case uploading for study residence permits and notes fee exemptions for certain Hungarian State Scholarship holders such as Stipendium Hungaricum.
reference_summary:
1. Enter Hungary is the online filing channel for student cases.
2. OIF publishes a student upload manual.
3. Some scholarship holders have fee-free procedures listed.
4. Stipendium Hungaricum can appear among those exemptions.
5. Follow the manual screenshots and attachment list.

title: Employer notification duties
document_excerpt: OIF factsheets describe employer and host-organization obligations regarding third-country nationals, including notification duties tied to employment.
reference_summary:
1. Employers of third-country nationals have OIF-stated duties.
2. Host organizations also face notification obligations.
3. Student workers may trigger employer reporting rules.
4. Read the employer obligations factsheet before hiring.
5. This is not a substitute for official OIF guidance.

title: Stipendium FAQ scope
document_excerpt: The Stipendium Hungaricum FAQ answers recurring applicant questions about calls, documents, and programme conditions in plain language linked to official calls.
reference_summary:
1. The SH FAQ answers common applicant questions.
2. It points back to official calls and regulations.
3. Topics include documents, eligibility, and process steps.
4. FAQ text is not a private case decision.
5. Prefer the call PDF when FAQ and call differ.

title: BA/MA call 2026/27
document_excerpt: The bachelor and master Stipendium call for 2026/27 sets application windows, eligible study levels, and programme conditions for that intake year.
reference_summary:
1. A dedicated BA/MA call covers the 2026/27 intake.
2. The call sets timing and eligible levels.
3. Applicants must follow that year’s document list.
4. Host programmes are constrained by the call text.
5. Download the official call PDF from the SH site.

title: PhD call 2026/27
document_excerpt: The doctoral Stipendium call for 2026/27 describes PhD application conditions separately from the bachelor and master call.
reference_summary:
1. Doctoral applicants use a separate SH call.
2. PhD conditions differ from BA/MA rules.
3. The 2026/27 call states that year’s requirements.
4. Research plans and documents follow the PhD list.
5. Cite the PhD call URL when answering doctoral questions.

title: ELTE programme lengths
document_excerpt: ELTE’s international guide describes bachelor, master, one-tier, and doctoral programme lengths and credit expectations for international students.
reference_summary:
1. ELTE publishes an international student guide.
2. Programme types have different semester lengths.
3. Credit expectations vary by programme type.
4. Doctoral paths require high credit totals over years.
5. Use the guide together with faculty rules.

title: Academic progress certificate
document_excerpt: Government Decree 35/2024 requires an educational-institution certificate of academic progress when extending a study residence permit.
reference_summary:
1. Decree 35/2024 is a Hungarian government text.
2. Study-permit extensions need an academic-progress certificate.
3. The certificate comes from the educational institution.
4. The decree text is published on NJT.
5. Attach the certificate in the Enter Hungary case.

title: Aliens policing framework
document_excerpt: Act XC of 2023 forms part of the Hungarian aliens-policing legal framework that residence and study-stay procedures sit under.
reference_summary:
1. Act XC of 2023 is primary Hungarian aliens-policing law.
2. Study residence procedures sit under that framework.
3. Factsheets translate operational steps for applicants.
4. Legal text on NJT is authoritative Hungarian wording.
5. This assistant paraphrases; it is not a court brief.

title: Hallgatói tartózkodás HU
document_excerpt: Az OIF magyar tájékoztatója a hallgatói tartózkodás szabályait ismerteti, beleértve a munkavállalásra és az eljárásokra vonatkozó nyilvános pontokat.
reference_summary:
1. Az OIF magyarul is közzéteszi a hallgatói tartózkodási tájékoztatót.
2. A szöveg a harmadik országbeli hallgatókra vonatkozik.
3. Munkavállalási korlátok a tájékoztatóban szerepelnek.
4. Eljárási lépések az Enter Hungary folyamathoz kapcsolódnak.
5. Döntés előtt az oif.gov.hu oldalt ellenőrizze.

title: SH application guide
document_excerpt: The Stipendium application guide for 2026/27 walks applicants through account creation, document upload, and submission order for the online application system.
reference_summary:
1. The SH application guide covers the online process.
2. Applicants create an account and upload documents.
3. Submission order follows the guide’s checklist.
4. The 2026/27 guide matches that intake year.
5. Use the guide with the relevant BA/MA or PhD call.
